name: Rotamead v Durston Scaffolding
description: Scaffolding hire: Rotamead claims £226,711.21 of hire charges (including the historic Paul Durston Ltd debt novated to DSL) plus ongoing hire and return of equipment; DSL and its guarantors say the novation and guarantee were signed under duress, Higgins took liability for site shortages, and DSL has overpaid.
